query: Draw a labeled diagram of a leaf showing blade, midrib, petiole and veins
full_prompt: Draw a labeled diagram of a leaf showing blade, midrib, petiole and veins
clip_prompt: leaf cross-section diagram, blade, midrib, petiole, veins, botanical illustration, educational, clean linework, white background, scientific diagram, no text labels
t5_prompt: An educational scientific diagram of a leaf structure showing all major anatomical components on a white background. The leaf blade forms the broad, flat photosynthetic surface with a smooth or slightly textured appearance. The midrib runs as a prominent central vein down the length of the blade, appearing as a slightly raised linear structure that provides structural support. The petiole extends from the base of the leaf blade as a slender stalk that connects the leaf to the stem, often appearing slightly cylindrical or flattened. Secondary veins branch laterally from the midrib in a pinnate or parallel pattern depending on leaf type, creating a network of vascular tissue that distributes water and nutrients throughout the blade. Tertiary veins form finer branching patterns connecting the secondary veins and completing the venation network. The entire leaf structure demonstrates the vascular bundles containing xylem and phloem tissues that transport fluids and sugars. The leaf margins are clearly defined, showing whether they are smooth, serrated, or lobed. The presentation should be a clean cross-sectional and surface view botanical illustration in a scientific textbook style with no background clutter, suitable for educational purposes in plant biology or botany curricula.
